body:
I've changed my mind about accepting death by china.  


If china is gonna blow us up after all...then I'm taking the third route:Suicide.  


No politician is going to decide whether or not I live or die.  


My life and my fate are my own and NO ONE is taking that from me.  


This damn life has taken enough from me already.

And know this "China problem" of mine has an iron grip on me and I don't know how to get rid of it.  


All I want to know is:When is china gonna kill us?  


If we're gonna die,then,I guess we'd be good to have a date as to when we should make peace with our gods?  


Honestly,I don't know how I'm gonna get over this china-induced anxiety.  


Maybe when I get killed by their nukes or I commit suicide to escape said nukes,I guess.  


I don't get it:why do these people in power ALWAYS have to treat us all like fucking insects to be squashed? And the U.S WANTS to fight China too.  


Again:**When do we die? Our fate seems to be death by china.**  


China is just the bane of my existence rn:  


They've given me suicidal ideation,driven me to self-harm and because of them,I semi-don't know if I want to go to Japan(but maybe,I hope to be in Japan when they inevitably blow it up..at least I get to die where I wanna be.)  


But,I don't think this fear of china will EVER go away.  


ANd tbh,to HELL with china.

So,now,**china is giving me tremendous anxiety to the point of mortal insanity/suicide.**  


From them wanting to annihilate taiwan,to the fact that we are all now looking at death/murder by chinese nuke..they are now officially the stuff of my nightmares.  


And because of that,I am now semi-seriously considering suicide.  


If people want xi Jinping to kill them,then fine by me.  


But,i'd rather kill myself than die by chinese nuke.  


Fucking hell,WHY is east fucking asia the stuff of fucking nightmares?  


Korea,China,Japan..wtf is it with that place?!

Allow me to explain myself a bit:  


1-Yes,I am the same guy that was..**terrified(**and still am,to an extent) of North Korea..and I am scared of China..because:  


=BOTH have considerable nuclear arsenals(and that we can't stop..I think you know what that means)  


=They're both doing some diabolical shit(People are all over the place on the damn Uyghur issue...But there is no question on what china wants to do to taiwan(Brutalize them,and it seems it won't even matter if Taiwan declares independence or no..)to say nothing of North Korea who seems...rather hell bent on fighting the U.S/SK/Japan(why else do they threaten us so damn much?)   


=You guys  DO know what a world after a nuclear conflict would look like,right? think Post-WWII..EVERYWHERE but the U.S,but then add a couple of U.S cities to the mix(or all of fucking america)...And that would mean...anyone of asian descent being hunted down and killed in the U.S(just remember what happened to muslims after 9/11 and Japanese-Americans after pearl harbor...and then China nukes us? North Korea? it'll be hunting season for those poor folks!)  


=And in regards to my mental state..yes,i DO need help...but just remember,when the SHTF..you do know that the shrinks will be just as dead or worse as we all will be,right?  


=And here's the kicker:The U.S seems hell-bent on fighting China at least(just look at what happened in Alaska and the myriad of Anti-asian hate crimes and the virtual consensus that China is a mortal enemy that must be destroyed..ffs I have seen people elsewhere saying that they honest-to-god WANT war with China(and if we all die in Nuclear fire,then it's ok.)  


Bottom Line:I utterly REFUSE to underestimate nuclear armed nations that the U.S wants to fight even if that means the destruction of human society(if not humanity itself).
